# Polygon Swap

> Polygon Swap is a non-custodial web interface for swapping POL, USDC, USDT and other tokens on Polygon PoS. Users connect their own wallet, review a routed quote and sign each transaction. The site never holds funds or keys.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Network: Polygon PoS, a proof-of-stake chain connected to Ethereum.
- Gas token: POL, the successor to MATIC, pays for every transaction.
- Typical pairs: POL, USDC and USDT, plus other ERC-20 tokens.
- USDC may exist as native USDC or as bridged USDC.e, which are separate contracts.
- Non-custodial: the user signs every swap and the interface never holds funds or keys.

## Pages

- Polygon Swap & learn: https://polygon-swap.github.io/
- Legal: https://polygon-swap.github.io/legal.html
